summary: Iteration 29: BM Per-Item Cod/Linha Feature Testing. Backend: 15/15 tests passed - all BM CRUD operations, calculate endpoint, PDF generation working correctly with per-item cod/linha values. Frontend: BM page loads but OS options not displayed due to 403 errors on API calls - authentication token not being sent with requests when navigating directly to BM page.

integration_issues.issue: Service Orders not displayed in the create modal. API calls to /api/bm, /api/service-orders, /api/client-prices return 403 Forbidden when navigating directly to /admin/boletim-medicao page. The authentication token is not being sent with requests.
integration_issues.root_cause: AsyncStorage token retrieval is async - when BM page loads and calls loadData(), the token may not be available yet in the axios interceptor. This is a race condition between page load and auth context initialization.
integration_issues.potential_fix: Add loading state check in BM page to wait for auth context to be ready before calling loadData(), or add retry logic for 403 responses

action_items: Fix frontend auth token race condition - BM page should wait for auth context to be ready before loading data
Add error handling in BM page loadData() to retry on 403 or show appropriate error message

rca_of_the_issue.issue: Frontend BM page shows empty OS picker - API calls return 403
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Race condition between page load and auth context initialization. The BM page's loadData() function is called in useEffect on mount, but the AsyncStorage.getItem('token') in the axios interceptor may not have completed yet, resulting in requests without Authorization header.
reproduction_steps: 3. Click 'Novo Boletim' - modal opens but no OS options displayed
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Add auth context check in BM page before loading data, or implement retry logic for 403 responses
